description: Sri Lanka  Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect From 13.04.2020 to 19.04.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it is a statutory instrument setting official exchange rates for customs purposes.
